correctness.rationale: The displayed monomial bases give equal Hilbert function (1,2,2), and the canonical square maps have different kernel dimensions. All automorphisms are determined by generator images; the defining relations and tangent invertibility yield exactly the two 32-element normal forms. The elementary abelian index-two subgroups are conjugated via the explicit basis map Psi with two unipotent Jordan blocks. A direct exhaustion of quadratic monomial subsets classifies the five-dimensional types and excludes all dimensions below five. The saved verify.py independently enumerates the four small algebras and checks all 1,024 homomorphism comparisons.

value.rationale: Automorphism-group reconstruction is a specific research theme of the verified 2024 primary paper. The example proves a genuinely group-structural collision, not simply an accidental equality of orders, while fixed dimension, embedding dimension and Hilbert function still fail to distinguish the rings. Its complete classification within the minimal natural two-generator monomial Hilbert type gives a sharp boundary for finite rational-point reconstruction. No invalid extension to characteristic-zero algebraic-group rigidity is claimed.
